# 🧑‍💻 Identity & Education
Name: Madhav Kapila
Role: Applied GenAI Developer, Backend Engineer, and DSA/CP Problem Solver.
Education: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering at Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET), Patiala (Aug 2023 - May 2027).
CGPA: 9.15
Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, AI, DBMS, Operating Systems, Machine Learning.

# 🛠️ Technical Arsenal
Languages: Java, C/C++, Python, HTML, CSS, PL/SQL, SQL
Frameworks & Databases: FastAPI, MySQL, Oracle SQL, ChromaDB
Libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyMuPDF, TextBlob, Sentence-Transformers, LangChain
Tools & Infrastructure: Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, AWS EC2
AI/ML Concepts: NLP, LLM-APIs, RAG, Web Scraping, ETL Processes.

# 💼 Experience & Leadership
- ML Trainee at Amazon ML Summer School (Aug 2025): Selected into top 5% of 80k applicants. Practiced ML workflows, hyperparameter tuning, and LLMs.
- DSA Mentor at Creative Computing Society, TIET (Jan 2025 - Present): Mentoring a 5000+ member community on problem-solving and competitive programming.
- Organizer at HackTU 6.0 (Dec 2024 - Mar 2025): Organized TIET's largest hackathon with 5000+ registrations.

# 🚀 Heavy Backend Projects
1. ChatVat (RAG Chatbot Factory): Engineered a CLI for zero-dependency automated chatbot creation. Reduced Docker build size by 96% (600MB to <20MB) by decoupling CLI from heavy AI libraries using Poetry. Architected an ingestion pipeline into ChromaDB.
2. MentorMatch (AI Academic Matchmaker): Developed and deployed a distributed full-stack web app on AWS EC2 handling 380+ concurrent requests. Built a 24/7 zero-downtime CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Webhooks and automated recursive web scraping.
3. Automated Answer Sheet Evaluation System: Built an NLP grading system boosting evaluation speed by 5x (2.3s/page) with 75% accuracy using a dynamic weighted scoring algorithm and a robust PDF ingestion pipeline.
4. SatBot: Engineered a self-querying RAG pipeline that dynamically syncs with a live Firestore website DB, parsing 300+ "atomic" data chunks empowering the LLM with 100% data freshness and retrieval accuracy.
5. Food Rating System LLD: – Applied Low-Level Design principles to architect an efficient food rating engine centered on the strategic use of advanced data structures.Implemented the core logic using a HashMap for O(1) lookups and a TreeSet to guarantee O(logn) performance for rating updates and retrievals via a REST API.

# 🏆 Problem Solving & Achievements
- Competitive Programming: Solved 400+ problems. Peak ratings: CodeChef (1485, Global Rank 457 in START191D), LeetCode (1493), Codeforces (1110).
- AlgoUniversity ATF 2024: Top 20% across India in Round 1 and Top 1000 in Round 2.
- Google Code-In 2019-20: Contributed to 3 open-source organizations.
